title: KampusPtsEventEnvelope
description: Standard durable event envelope contract for Kampus PTS modular monolith and asynchronous outbox dispatching.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this specific event occurrence.

eventType.description: Domain event type name (e.g., PassageConfirmed, PaymentCaptured, JournalEntryPosted).

schemaVersion.description: Semantic schema version of the event envelope and payload.

occurredAtUtc.description: Timestamp when the domain event occurred in UTC.

receivedAtUtc.description: Timestamp when the event was ingested or recorded into the outbox in UTC.

sourceSystem.description: Source module or subsystem producing the event.

correlationId.description: Trace correlation identifier across the distributed execution flow.

causationId.description: Identifier of the command or parent event that caused this event.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key guaranteeing duplicate dispatch suppression.

payloadHash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the canonical payload.

tenantId.description: Tenant or campus identifier for multi-tenancy isolation.

legalEntityId.description: Legal business entity identifier according to financial authority matrix.
